reporting_notes.enrollment: Counts reflect authorized schools and grade-level groups; district-wide coverage is not implied.
reporting_notes.attendance: Limited-use results follow independent quality approval. Affected source records are excluded before aggregation; chronic-absence percentages use eligible students, not attendance sessions.
reporting_notes.outcomes: Each subject contributes assessment participations; the same student may appear in more than one subject. Multi-subject totals and weighted proficiency rates are assessment-participation measures, not deduplicated student headcounts. Distinct student counts are not available in this published dataset.

enrolled.name: Enrolled students
enrolled.definition: Enrollment headcount at the approved reporting cutoff, aggregated by grade.
enrolled.basis: Sum of authorized grade-level enrollment counts

new_enrollments.name: New enrollments
new_enrollments.definition: New school enrollments recorded for the defined reporting period.

active.name: Active students
active.definition: Active enrolled students at the reporting cutoff.
active.basis: Sum of authorized grade-level active counts

attendance_rate.name: Attendance rate
attendance_rate.definition: Share of eligible sessions attended among the authorized reporting population.

chronic_rate.name: Chronic absence
chronic_rate.definition: Share of eligible student-month observations marked chronically absent in the selected period. Combining months counts student-month observations, not unique students.
chronic_rate.basis: Chronically absent student-month observations / eligible student-month observations × 100

eligible_sessions.name: Eligible sessions
eligible_sessions.definition: Attendance sessions remaining eligible after independently approved record exclusions.
eligible_sessions.basis: Sum of eligible sessions after exclusion

participants.name: Subject assessment participations
participants.definition: Count of assessment participations within the selected subjects and reporting cohorts. The same learner may contribute to more than one subject.
participants.basis: Sum of subject-level assessment participation counts; not distinct students

proficient_count.name: Proficient subject assessments
proficient_count.definition: Count of eligible subject assessment participations reaching the approved proficiency threshold; an individual may contribute in multiple subjects.
proficient_count.basis: Sum of proficient subject assessment participations

proficiency_pct.name: Assessment participation proficiency rate
proficiency_pct.definition: Proficient subject assessment participations divided by all eligible subject assessment participations. This is not the percentage of distinct students who are proficient in every subject.
proficiency_pct.basis: Proficient subject assessment participations / eligible subject assessment participations × 100
